title: Dickinson v. Dodds — opening and later discussion
shortTitle: Dickinson v. Dodds — opening and later discussion
summary: The opening presents a written land offer; later assigned notes discuss the distinction between a stated deadline and enforceable irrevocability.
notes: The central opinion at pp. 243–245 is unassigned. The later discussion criticizes reliance on consideration to support a promise to hold open and introduces the firm-offer alternative. This node does not pretend that the complete Dickinson decision has been assigned or separately briefed.
